root@1cc2f34a-37df-43e7-8fc4-e7edc7b51b89:/home/user/myproject# cat > parse.ts << 'EOF'
> import fs from 'node:fs';
> import path from 'node:path';
> import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
> import pLimit from 'p-limit';
> import LlamaCloud from '@llamaindex/llama-cloud';
>
> const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
> const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
>
> const INPUTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'inputs');
> const OUTPUTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'outputs');
> const LOG_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'output.log');
> const RUN_ID_PATH = '/logs/artifacts/run-id';
>
> async function main(): Promise<void> {
>   const runId = fs.readFileSync(RUN_ID_PATH, 'utf8').trim();
>
>   if (!fs.existsSync(OUTPUTS_DIR)) {
>     fs.mkdirSync(OUTPUTS_DIR, { recursive: true });
>   }
>
>   const pdfFiles = fs
>     .readdirSync(INPUTS_DIR)
>     .filter((f) => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf'))
>     .sort();
>
>   if (pdfFiles.length === 0) {
>     console.error('No PDF files found in', INPUTS_DIR);
>     process.exit(1);
>   }
>
>   const client = new LlamaCloud({ apiKey: process.env.LLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY });
>
>   const limit = pLimit(2);
>
>   const logLines: string[] = [];
>
>   const tasks = pdfFiles.map((pdfName) =>
>     limit(async () => {
>       const basename = path.basename(pdfName, path.extname(pdfName));
>       const inputPath = path.join(INPUTS_DIR, pdfName);
>       const outputPath = path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, `${basename}.md`);
>       const externalFileId = `${runId}-${basename}`;
>
>       console.log(`[${pdfName}] uploading (external_file_id=${externalFileId})...`);
>       const uploaded = await client.files.create({
>         file: fs.createReadStream(inputPath),
>         purpose: 'parse',
>         external_file_id: externalFileId,
>       });
>
>       console.log(`[${pdfName}] parsing (file_id=${uploaded.id})...`);
>       const result = await client.parsing.parse({
>         file_id: uploaded.id,
>         tier: 'cost_effective',
>         version: 'latest',
>         expand: ['markdown'],
>       });
>
>       const pages = result.markdown?.pages ?? [];
>       const joined = pages
>         .map((p) => (p as { markdown?: string }).markdown ?? '')
>         .join('\n\n---\n\n');
>
>       fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, joined, 'utf8');
>
>       const logLine = `Parsed: ${pdfName} | pages: ${pages.length}`;
>       logLines.push(logLine);
>       console.log(logLine);
>
>       return logLine;
>     }),
>   );
>
>   await Promise.all(tasks);
>
>   fs.writeFileSync(LOG_PATH, logLines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
>   console.log(`Wrote ${logLines.length} log lines to ${LOG_PATH}`);
> }
>
> main().catch((err) => {
>   console.error('Fatal error:', err);
>   process.exit(1);
> });
> EOF
